Handing out water bottles is a pre-race activity unrelated to whether the runners set off together.
Pinning numbers onto shirts is unrelated to Wren carrying snacks in a backpack.
Volunteers pinning numbers is unrelated to someone handing out flyers about the charity.
Volunteers pinning numbers onto shirts has no bearing on children waving flags near the finish.
Music playing from a speaker has nothing to do with Mina's height relative to Leo.
Dara's shoe color is unrelated to the temperature of the morning air.
Wren carrying snacks is unrelated to Mina checking her watch and smiling.
Wren's backpack of snacks has no bearing on Mina greeting familiar faces.
Wren carrying snacks is unrelated to the order of arrival between Leo and Wren.
Wren carrying a backpack of snacks is unrelated to the arrival order between Wren and Dara.
Wren's snack-carrying is unrelated to the sun's position in the sky.

Hugo booking a hall is unrelated to cheers rising as the race began.
